findings.antecedent: Buildings
findings.consequent: Human behavior and psychology
findings.quote: "we shape our buildings and afterwards our buildings shape us" [1].

findings.antecedent: Hippocampus activation by sensory stimuli (visual, auditory, olfactory, somatosensory)
findings.consequent: Formation of new memories and environmental mapping; shaping human behaviors
key_citations: Izci, Y., and Erbaş, Y. C., 2015
findings.quote: Recent neurological studies reveals that particular cells in the human brain hippocampus responsible from the location, is activated by any sensory stimulus such as the visual, auditory (hearing), olfactory (smell), and somatosensory (touch) systems and it plays critical role in the formation of new memories and environmental mappping [2].

findings.antecedent: Objects in spatial connections with each other
findings.consequent: Positive development of individual's sense of direction; feeling a sense of belonging
key_citations: Izci, Y., and Erbaş, Y. C., 2015
findings.quote: The studies have underlined that the requirement that the objects are in spatial connections with each other is related to the positive development of the individual's sense of direction and this is one of the primary factors for the individual to feel the sense of belonging.

findings.antecedent: Difficulty in finding direction in places
findings.consequent: Occurrence of negative emotions (sense of being lost)
findings.quote: Places in which people have difficulty in finding their direction is closely associated with occurrence of negative emotions in human psychology, in terms of sense of being lost in particular [3].

findings.antecedent: Details in architecture façades and interior designs
findings.consequent: Trace in human psychology
findings.quote: Besides, it is stated that starting from details in the architecture façades, interior designs, too, leave a trace in human psychology [4].

findings.antecedent: Danger signals received in the living environment
findings.consequent: Intensity of individuals' stressful lives; deterioration of psychologies (decrease of energy, block of creativity, exhaustion of hopes, weakening of personalities)
findings.quote: Danger signals received in the living environment increase the intensity of individuals' stressful lives and it manifests itself with psychologies that deteriorate on an individual basis, such as the decrease of energy of life, the block of creativity, the exhaustion of hopes, and the weakening of personalities [5].

findings.antecedent: Architecture
findings.consequent: Unearths creativity in the spirit of a person and products of creativity in the emotional sense
findings.quote: Architecture, already, is a notion that unearths the creativity in the spirit of a person and the products of this creativity in the emotional sense [6].

findings.antecedent: Inadequate exposure to sunlight
findings.consequent: Frequency of depression cases
findings.quote: Scientific studies have shown that there is a significant association between the frequency of depression cases and inadequate exposure to sunlight [7].

findings.antecedent: Predominant apartment types (1+1, 2+1) in today's property market
findings.consequent: Failure to meet people's needs for disintegration, differentiation in relationships, and creating private spaces; offered to consumer society rather than human needs
findings.quote: predominant apartments in the style of 1 bedroom + living room and 2 bedrooms + living room (1+1 and 2+1) are far from designs to meet people's needs for disintegration and differentiation in their relationships with others and creating private spaces. These apartment type dwellings are structures designed for the sake of getting unearned income and offered to the consumer society rather than human needs oriented architectural designs.

findings.antecedent: Crowded open office spaces
findings.consequent: Difficulty in establishing/maintaining in-depth relationships; negativity in private space perception
findings.quote: The private space notion in the spatial design that reflects in human psychology and relationships as negativity manifests itself in the office designs of individuals in their business lives. The crowded communities taking place in an open and wide space and trying to manufacture thereby do not reflect positively in terms of establishing and maintaining an in-depth relationship under these conditions [12].

findings.antecedent: Feeling belonging in environment
findings.consequent: Happiness
findings.quote: Kürkçüoğlu, too, states that it is of great importance for people to feel belonging in order to be happy in their environment.

findings.antecedent: Green color tone (symbol of peace, tranquility, abundance, renewal)
findings.consequent: More positive impressions on human psychology
findings.quote: Compared to an environment with a gray color tone, which is the symbol of concepts such as monotony, formality, seriousness, and tediousness, the green color tone, which is the symbol of concepts such as peace, tranquility, abundance, renewal, leaves more positive impressions on human psychology.

findings.antecedent: Feeling of security risk, uneasiness, fear, and unhappiness in the living environment
findings.consequent: Alienation from environment; estranged from sense of belonging
findings.quote: The feeling of security risk, uneasiness, fear, and unhappiness in the living environment leads to alienation from there and being estranged from the sense of belonging.

findings.antecedent: Alienation (from environment/belonging)
findings.consequent: Negative effects on interactions of people living in the same environment
findings.quote: This alienation, on the other hand, negatively affects the interactions of people living in the same environment with each other [13].

findings.antecedent: Dwellings/workplaces constructed ignoring human psychology
findings.consequent: Disturbance of social 'communal' lives; psychological problems; alienation from the city
findings.quote: In short, dwellings and even workplaces constructed ignoring human psychology disturb social "communal" lives. ... When people's order is disturbed, psychological problems begin, and in this case, the person starts not to see himself/herself as a part of the city anymore, and thus, he/she alienates from the city he/she lives.

findings.antecedent: Pruitt-Igoe complex (small apartments, skip-stop elevators, communal corridors, poor ventilation, no centralized AC, racial segregation, lack of maintenance)
findings.consequent: Deterioration into a decaying, dangerous, crime-infested neighborhood; abandonment; architectural failure
findings.quote: The most painful example of dwellings constructed without considering human psychology is the Pruitt-Igoe buildings. ... By the end of the 1960s, all authors agree that Pruitt-Igoe was nearly abandoned and had deteriorated into a decaying, dangerous, crime-infested neighborhood; its architect lamented: "I never thought people were that destructive".

findings.antecedent: Mutual opening of doors in Samanbahce houses
findings.consequent: Air circulation; natural air conditioning
findings.quote: Thanks to the mutual opening of the doors, air circulation occurs in the entrance hall and natural air conditioning is achieved.

findings.antecedent: Two-part window shutters (lower fixed, upper openable) in Samanbahce houses
findings.consequent: Passers-by cannot see inside; air circulation ensured
findings.quote: Shutters are made of two parts, thus, particularly the lower part of window shutters opening up onto the road is fixed, while the upper part is opened. Thus, passers-by cannot see the inside of the room, and because the upper part is openable, air circulation is ensured by being opposite the window opening out to the courtyard.

findings.antecedent: Modern insulation materials instead of loam (soil) on roofs during restoration of Samanbahce houses
findings.consequent: Negative effects on natural air conditioning/thermal comfort
findings.quote: Some users, despite all their objections, state that modern insulation materials are used instead of loam (soil) on roofs during the restoration works carried out with the financial support of UNDP (United Nations Development Programme) between 2003-2004 and that this event negatively affects natural air conditioning, in other words, thermal comfort.

findings.antecedent: Room without window opening to courtyard (in later Samanbahce additions)
findings.consequent: Blocked air circulation; affected natural climate
findings.quote: The fact that the room was not built with a window opening to the courtyard affected the natural climate, because air circulation is blocked.

findings.antecedent: Courtyards (in Lefkosa traditional houses)
findings.consequent: Function as backyard/transition area; symbolize green color; contribute to natural climate (evaporative cooling)
findings.quote: As in this site, when the traditional houses inside the city walls of Lefkosa (Nicosia) are examined, courtyards are the backyard, which is the transition area from living spaces to service spaces, rather than the inner courtyard that spreads to other countries of the world in Central Asia and the Roman period [23]. ... Courtyards also symbolize the green color. and are also part of the natural climate. This is due fact that in the evaporative cooling process water absorbs relatively large amount of heat [24].

findings.antecedent: Housing projects failing to meet needs for disintegration, differentiation, and private space
findings.consequent: Prevention of sense of belonging; leading to mental depression
findings.quote: As a result, the housing projects constructed are far from meeting the needs of disintegration, differentiation and private space in people's relations with each other. This situation prevents people from feeling a sense of belonging to the place they live in and leads people to be mentally depressed.
